answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 7842 Country: United Arab Emirates Title: My wife suffering from yellowish white discharge from vagina,in very less quanity, but visible in the panties,each prayer she change panties, wash and take wudu , this is what she following,as she is housewife it is not difficult for her, Now we are palnning to go for Holy Hajj this year insha allah,How she can manage prayers during hajj?will this problem affect her Hajj, what is your suggestion, shall we go for medical treatment, or she can take pray with this discharge,wudu will be void? please advise. Question: My wife suffering from yellowish white discharge from vagina,in very less quanity, but visible in the panties,each prayer she change panties, wash and take wudu , this is what she following,as she is housewife it is not difficult for her, Now we are palnning to go for Holy Hajj this year insha allah,How she can manage prayers during hajj?will this problem affect her Hajj, what is your suggestion, shall we go for medical treatment, or she can take pray with this discharge,wudu will be void? please advise. Answer ID: 7842 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1827/1555=B/1429) If she does not find so much time in which she can perform salah in a state of purity, then she is mazoor (excused), she should make fresh wudhu in every salah time and perform obligatory salah of the time and as much nafl as she wants. Her salah will be valid even if the yellowish white discharge continues while offering salah . You should get her treated before going to Hajj so that she may do tawaf easily while being pure. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
